verdict.rationale: Fern's docs say it serves clean Markdown for any documentation page when `.md` or `.mdx` is appended to the URL (fern-docs-6), and its live llms.txt tells agents to do exactly that (fern-probe-1). Several `.md` URLs in the pack (sdks.md, cli.md, post/*.md) resolve as sources, which corroborates the behavior. However, a probe of the `/learn.md` section root returned 404 (fern-probe-2), so coverage of 'every' page is not fully confirmed. Missing for 10: confirmation that index/landing URLs like /learn also serve .md, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-hosted pages.
